name: Saelienne
summary: On the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus, Saelienne keeps an inn for travelers and artisans. She offers food, drink, and a place to bind a Hearthstone in the night elven capital.

sections.title: Hospitality on the Terrace
sections.body: Innkeeper Saelienne welcomes residents and visitors to her inn on Darnassus's Craftsmen's Terrace. She gives travelers a calm place to rest and serves night elven refreshments and goods brought through the city port. Tradesfolk come in after long hours at the forge or loom. Saelienne's inn gives them a place to gather and recover.

faq.q: Where can I find Innkeeper Saelienne?
faq.answer: You can find Saelienne on the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus, among the trade trainers and crafting shops.
Saelienne offers food and drink, and lets you bind your Hearthstone to Darnassus.

faq.q: Does Saelienne offer any seasonal tasks?
faq.answer: During Hallow's End, Saelienne offers Alliance adventurers Dancing for Marzipan in exchange for holiday treats.

angles.text: As a night elf adventurer returning from Teldrassil's wild reaches, you can find a familiar hearth among Darnassus's artisans at Saelienne's inn.
As an Alliance envoy or tradesfolk traveling to Teldrassil, you can find food, drink, and a warm hearthstone refuge at Saelienne's inn.
